mstts:express-as.prosody:
As we wrap up, let's take a moment to bring all of this together.
Progress in America? It's never been a straight shot forward. Every leap is met with resistance, pushback, and sometimes even heartbreak. But that's just part of the story.
The way we talk about where we've been—and where we're going—shapes what we believe is possible. Those stories really matter.
Real change? It doesn't just happen on its own. It takes guts, from you and from me, and it needs a group effort that keeps going, even when things get tough. The fight for justice is ongoing. It's never fully won, never completely safe.
Hope is powerful, but it's not enough by itself. It needs to walk hand in hand with honesty, with seeing the world as it truly is, and with sticking it out, especially when the path winds and dips.
Looking back on these eight years—and beyond—reminds us that history moves in cycles, with victories and setbacks, hope and disappointment. Building a better world is a job that's never really finished. Each generation adds its chapter, through the choices we make and the stories we share.
So, if you ever feel worn out by setbacks or weighed down by what’s come before, remember: you’re not alone in this. The struggle for justice and equality belongs to all of us. Every brave step, every honest conversation, every time you refuse to just accept things as they are, you’re helping to move us closer to the world we believe in.
Keep moving forward. Your part in this story matters—and the next chapter is still waiting to be written.
